title: Microsoft Just Fixed the Marketplace! Plus: A380 & Cessna 408 Review
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the landmines on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a massive wave of recent Marketplace developments that represent a monumental shift for the flight simulation community.

We dive deep into the groundbreaking announcement straight from the team. In an official forum thread titled "Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace partner announcement," Microsoft confirmed that the highly controversial developer MScenery has been completely banned and scrubbed from the storefront. After years of low-quality models, misleading images, and suspicious five-star scores, the marketplace is finally starting to heal. No longer will legitimate products have to compete with manipulative scores.

With all that noise out of the way, we shift focus to developers putting real effort into the engine. First up is the Cessna 408 Sky Courier. Originally locked behind more expensive editions, this twin-turboprop high-wing utility workhorse is now available standalone in the marketplace! We explore its highly detailed systems, passenger and cargo variants, and how you can put its 6,000-pound capacity to work in career mode or private charter missions.

Next, we command a super heavy: the all-new Airbus A380-800 from Latin VFR (LVFR). This accessible long-haul giant adds another massive option to the skies, featuring advanced clear-coat paint rendering, a working EFB packed with options, responsive autopilot functionality, and highly detailed cabin interiors including the stunning Emirates, Lufthansa, and Qatar configurations.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know what's in your hangar!
